newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guoco buys HK$2.567 bln office property.
newsitem.headline: Guoco buys HK$2.567 bln office property.

text.p: Guoco Group Ltd said on Monday it will buy part of a retail and office development in Hong Kong's Central district for HK$2.567 billion.

Guoco said it would buy nine office floors, and the ground and upper ground floors of a development being built at the corner of Jubilee Street and Queen's Road Central from the Land Development Corp and a unit of Cheung Kong (Holdings).
The group said it would fund the purchase by external borrowings.

Guoco said Dao Heng Bank Ltd, a wholly-owned unit of its 70-percent owned Dao Heng Bank Group Ltd, would buy the banking hall on the ground floor, the upper ground floor, and three other office floors for HK$1.353 billion.

Supreme Goal Investments Ltd, a wholly-owned unit of Guoco's 70-percent owned Guoco Land Ltd, would buy the other six office floors of the development as investment property for HK$1.214 billion, it said.

Guoco said the purchase would enable Dao Heng Bank to establish new headquarters and a principal banking hall in the Central district in Hong Kong, to rationalise management functions and to centralise selected business divisions in order to improve operational effectiveness and efficiency.
The Director of Lands has consented to the agreement, as required because the certificate of complainces in respect of the development has not yet been issued, it said.
